question: A rectangular piece of paper is 50 cm long and 22 cm wide. If a cylinder is formed by rolling the paper along its breadth, then the volume of the cylinder is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When rolled along its breadth, Breadth (B) = Circumference, and Length (L) = Height.

Direct formula for Volume = (B² × L) ÷ 4π

Volume = (22 × 22 × 50 × 7) ÷ (4 × 22)

Volume = 7700 ÷ 4 = 1925 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1925 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f04c7b44d5ff43c7f6796feb371b0dd52694522517860d696e37db25cb2be686.png] 

**Given:**

Length of paper (l) = 50 cm

Breadth of paper (b) = 22 cm

When the rectangular sheet is rolled along its breadth:

Circumference of the cylinder's base = 22 cm

Height of the cylinder (h) = 50 cm

**Formula Used:**

Circumference = 2πr

Volume of Cylinder = πr²h

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × r = 22

⇒ r = (22 × 7) ÷ (2 × 22)

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 3.5 × 3.5 × 50

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × (7/2) × (7/2) × 50

⇒ Volume = 11 × 7 × 25

⇒ Volume = 1925 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1925 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rolling a Rectangular Sheet

When rolled along its length, the length forms the circumference and the breadth becomes the height. When rolled along its breadth, the breadth forms the circumference and the length becomes the height.

Surface Areas of a Cylinder

The Curved Surface Area (CSA) is given by 2πrh, and the Total Surface Area (TSA) is 2πr(h + r), where r is the radius and h is the height.

Relationship with Cone

A cylinder and a cone with the same base radius and height have volumes in the ratio 3:1. The volume of the cone is 1/3 × πr²h.
